question.problem:
Suppose $X$ and $Y$ are discrete random variables. Let the joint CDF of $X$ and $Y$ be $F(x,y),$ where

$$
F(5,1)=0.67,\,F(3,1)=0.43\,F(1,1)=0.2,
$$

and the supports of $X$ and $Y$, respectively, are

$$
{S}_{X}=\{1,2,3,4,5\},\,{S}_{Y}=\{-2,-1,0,1,2\}.
$$

Find $P(X>3,Y<2).$
question.worked_solution:
Note the following:

- For a given joint PMF $f(x,y),$ we can think of each point where $f(x,y)\ne 0$ as a point mass in the plane, where the "probability mass" at each point equals the probability associated with that point.

- The joint CDF $F(x,y)=P(X\le x,Y\le y)$ is the total "probability mass" that lies in the infinite rectangular region that has its top-right corner at $(x,y)$ and whose sides are parallel to the coordinate axis.

Given the supports of $X$ and $Y,$ the joint support $S$ is a subset of

$$
{S}_{X}\times {S}_{Y}=\{1,2,3,4,5\}\times \{-2,-1,0,1,2\}.
$$

Let's plot the points in ${S}_{X}\times {S}_{Y},$ which contains the joint support, and sketch the region corresponding to the probability we wish to find.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14157784/assets/cdb5c8084958ba3dc1175c1e92035d89fb4edcdf8ce333962b49f22b40552f71.png)

Notice that this region encompasses the same possible support points as the infinite rectangle with its top-right corner at $(5,1)$ and top-left corner at $(3,1),$ where the top and right boundaries are included, and the left boundary is excluded.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14157784/assets/1c28f3e2f820511a30aa64ccd3affacaa6d72e69da9c596827429b244bf1129a.png)

Geometrically, this region can be obtained by taking all points in the infinite rectangle that has its top-right corner at $(5,1)$ (the blue region below) and *subtracting* all points in the infinite rectangle that has its top-right corner at $(3,1)$ (the red region below).

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14157784/assets/ae993ae6e8c0d71a42ca0e11ed5b30a8d762b3fab12771247eca262f0131c4f5.png)

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X>3,Y<2) & =\overset{\text{top-right corner at }(5,1)}{\overset{⏞}{P(X\le 5,Y\le 1)}}-\overset{\text{top-right corner at }(3,1)}{\overset{⏞}{P(X\le 3,Y\le 1)}} \\  & =F(5,1)-F(3,1) \\  & =0.67-0.43 \\  & =0.24.\end{aligned}
$$
